<!--
Template for the package pages. scripts/make_pages.R creates one page per
package in package/, which sets `pkg` and includes this file.
-->

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
status <- read_status()
apis <- read_apis()
p <- find_package(status, pkg)
g <- p$github
cr <- p$cran
u <- p$runiverse
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
md(p$title %||% g$description %||% "")
if (!is.null(p$maintainer)) md("Maintainer: ", sub(" <.*", "", p$maintainer))
links <- c(
  sprintf("[GitHub](%s)", g$url),
  if (!is.null(cr$url)) sprintf("[CRAN](%s)", cr$url),
  if (!is.null(u)) sprintf("[r-universe](%s)", u$url),
  if (!is.null(g$homepage)) sprintf("[Website](%s)", g$homepage)
)
md(paste(links, collapse = " · "))
if (!is.null(p$notes)) md("::: {.callout-note}\n", p$notes, "\n:::")
```

## Status

```{r}
#| results: asis
md(as.character(health_badge(p$health)))
md_list(vapply(p$issues, `[[`, "", "text"), empty = "No problems found.")
```

## Versions

```{r}
#| results: asis
md_table(
  data.frame(
    Source = c("GitHub", "CRAN", "r-universe"),
    Version = c(
      g$version %||% "",
      cr$version %||% "",
      u$version %||% ""
    ),
    Details = c(
      sprintf("Default branch `%s`, last commit %s", g$default_branch %||% "?", substr(g$last_commit %||% "", 1, 10)),
      switch(cr$status,
        cran = paste0("Published ", cr$published),
        archived = cr$comment %||% "Archived",
        "Not on CRAN"
      ),
      if (is.null(u)) "Not on the ICES r-universe" else paste0("`", u$universe, "`, build ", u$build_status, ", checks ", u$checks$worst %||% "?")
    )
  )
)
```

## CRAN

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (cr$status == "cran") {
  md("Version ", cr$version, ", published ", cr$published, ".",
     if (!is.null(cr$first_release)) paste0(" First released ", cr$first_release, "."))
  if (!is.null(cr$deadline)) md("**Deadline: ", cr$deadline, "**. The package will be archived unless the problems are fixed.")
  if (!is.null(cr$checks)) {
    counts <- unlist(cr$checks$counts)
    counts <- counts[counts > 0]
    md("[Check results](", cr$checks$url, "): ", paste(counts, names(counts), collapse = ", "), ".")
  }
  if (length(cr$additional_issues)) md("Additional issues: ", paste(unlist(cr$additional_issues), collapse = ", "), ".")
} else if (cr$status == "archived") {
  md("Archived on CRAN. ", cr$comment %||% "")
  if (!is.null(cr$first_release)) md("First released ", cr$first_release, ", ", cr$archived_versions, if (cr$archived_versions == 1) " version" else " versions", " in the archive.")
} else {
  md("Not on CRAN.")
}
```

## Dependencies

```{r}
#| results: asis
direct <- unlist(p$direct_dependencies)
all <- unlist(p$all_dependencies)
md(length(direct), " direct and ", length(all), " in total, excluding base R packages.")
if (length(direct)) md("Direct: ", paste(package_link(direct, status, from = "package"), collapse = ", "), ".")
if (length(all) > length(direct)) {
  md('::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="All ', length(all), ' dependencies"}\n',
     paste(package_link(all, status, from = "package"), collapse = ", "), "\n:::")
}
md("**Uses ICES packages:** ",
   if (length(p$ices_dependencies)) paste(package_link(unlist(p$ices_dependencies), status, from = "package"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
md("**Used by ICES packages:** ",
   if (length(p$ices_reverse_dependencies)) paste(package_link(unlist(p$ices_reverse_dependencies), status, from = "package"), collapse = ", ") else "none")
```

## Web services

```{r}
#| results: asis
used <- package_apis(apis, p)
api_line <- function(a) sprintf("[%s](../api/%s.html): %s", a$name, a$id, api_status_label[[if (a$health == "ok") "ok" else if (a$health == "error") "error" else "changed"]])
if (length(used$direct)) {
  md("Calls directly:")
  md_list(vapply(used$direct, api_line, ""))
}
if (length(used$via)) {
  md("Through its dependencies:")
  md_list(vapply(used$via, function(a) paste0(api_line(a), " (via ", paste(intersect(unlist(a$packages), unlist(p$all_dependencies)), collapse = ", "), ")"), ""))
}
if (!length(used$direct) && !length(used$via)) {
  md("None of the [checked web services](../apis.html).")
}
```

if (!is.null(g$last_commit)) md("Last commit on `", g$default_branch, "`, ", substr(g$last_commit, 1, 10), ": ", g$last_commit_message %||% "")
